standard.summary: 学习率自动增长上界（D-Adaptation 自动放大 lr 的速度上限；留空 = 不设上界）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The upper bound on automatic learning-rate growth (a speed limit on how fast D-Adaptation may raise lr; blank = no bound).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 学习率自动增长上界（D-Adapt 步长估计允许每步最多增长多少倍）。推荐 inf（不限制）。

advanced_en.principle: Upper bound on automatic learning-rate growth (how many times the D-Adapt step-size estimate may grow per step at most). Recommended inf (unlimited).
